name: Cisco ASA — SSH Proxy / Tunnel-Like Activity
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter _raw_log contains "302014"
| alter proxy_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
        ssh_tgt    = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_ip,
        svc_port   = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.src_port),
        bytes_n    = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.transferred_bytes)
| filter svc_port = 22
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count_distinct(ssh_tgt) as victims, sum(bytes_n) as total_bytes by proxy_host, _time
| filter victims >= 6 and total_bytes >= 10000000
| fields proxy_host
description: Single source SSH'ing to many internal targets with proxy-like byte volume.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — SSH Proxy / Tunnel-Like Activity
